blessings.why: Nullifies Underworld Boons; RPG Site calls it extremely useful for the flight.
Mov +2 to reach the escape tiles (Game8).

deploy.note: 13 slots, same 13 for both battles: Lilian and Nuzzuo chip shields, Tobias and Simon finish the cocoon, Noctula holds a flank. Nydine and Alexandra sit; Loretta keeps Sword EXP for The Blade.

tips.text: Lyrah: chip shields from the corners with weak ranged hits, then the heavy hitters
Her cocoon starts the same turn phase 1 ends and heals on every hit: only big hits
Flight: Theodora and the strongest go down the western edge; the upper-right group turtles
Bring Lysander's Cleansing Blade to clear enemies standing on the escape tiles

exitExtra.text: Before the Door of Destiny: decide whether to skip Part II on Dietrich, Cai and Leda so their armies join in Section 2
